name: PIR Motion Sensor
fullName: HC-SR501 Pyroelectric Passive Infrared Motion Sensor Module
tagline: Detects infrared body heat emissions to sense human/animal movement
description: The HC-SR501 PIR sensor detects infrared radiation emitted by warm moving bodies. It features a Fresnel lens that splits the detection field into optical zones, paired with a BISS0001 processing IC with adjustable delay time and sensitivity potentiometers.

specs.delayTime: 0.3 seconds to 5 minutes (adjustable via Tx potentiometer)
specs.triggerMode: L (single trigger) or H (repeat trigger) via jumper

pinout.name: Signal
pinout.desc: 3.3V HIGH when motion detected, 0V LOW when idle

wiringNote: Allow a 30 to 60 second warm-up period after powering on before reading reliable motion pulses.
commonMistakes: Reading sensor during its initial 60s warm-up calibration cycle
Pointing directly at air conditioners, heaters, or sunlight which trigger false positives
